scope: Authenticated HTTP QA of the exact Vercel Preview; GET requests only. Production alias unchanged. No authorization for Phase 2 or merge.

checksDifference.reason: The checker omits 98 HTTP indexable response-header assertions on *.vercel.app because platform edge noindex is independent of app robots HTML. The 98 app indexable HTML assertions remain mandatory; the 8 noindex pages also retain strict HTML robots/googlebot checks. Local HTTP header assertions pass.

limits: Preview headers differ from the local app headers because Vercel can inject noindex. This does not justify removing noindex from production.
Four itinerary responses retain their application X-Robots-Tag index, follow; 102 other response headers change from empty locally to noindex on Preview.
HTTP/HTML QA is not proof of Google indexing, ranking or traffic changes.
The public deployment URL is retained without its temporary access material; share URLs, tokens, cookies and loader code are excluded.
No screenshots, responsive audit or Lighthouse results are inferred from this HTTP report.
